lines.quote: every cultural artifact since 2014… a hype cycle, riling up two well-defined groups
lines.note: names the sorting machine — the long 2014

lines.quote: they refined what gets people's attention — and it's often the most base thing
how polarizing the response has been — but it doesn't follow the culture-war lines
this one pushed buttons, but not in a really mappable way

everybody I like personally, who I think is smart, really likes this movie — and people who wear Plantasia tote bags, or pin their identity to a political movement of the past eight years, just cannot understand it
lines.note: sorts the film's audience into the smart and the tote bags — about the people, not the film

lines.quote: this movie is a fuck you to every compromise
somebody comes along later and articulates why it was done, post hoc — by then it's already too late; savor these things in the moment
when we sit down and amicably discuss things — that's utopia in and of itself
lines.note: the movie's own claim, taken up

lines.quote: the biggest fuck you to the concept of the end of history — an anti end of history movie
it feels like this weird inertia people have been put under — and it's growing stronger
you literally are a cuck… a non-productive person, a non-creator
lines.note: the burn, aimed at the online right — read the same as anyone's

lines.quote: they equate recognition with influence and mattering — there's no correlation there anymore
the club — the one part where he loses his ability to stop time, because he's indulging in society shit
if you don't have finance backing you, you have to come with your own story and you have to be able to articulate it
lines.note: the same sentence Solana says, from the other corner

lines.quote: system calls from 1970s AT&T manuals; TCP/IP barely changed since the 80s — these things have ideological assumptions built in, social media too
utopianism is good; imagination and creativity need to be affirmed — it's not that hard
an ontological argument… these structures are much more contingent than we think
